# Semantic Atlas

> Obsidian community plugin that maps a vault by meaning: related notes, semantic search, themes, bridges between topics, missing links, and a comparison of the structure built by hand with the one meaning reveals. Computed on the device.

## Documentation

- [Semantic Atlas](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/README.md): Map your Obsidian vault by meaning, not only by links:
- [Changelog](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): This page describes the code as it is. The target architecture is in [SPEC.md, section 4](SPEC.md#4-organisation-des-dépôts-et-architecture).
- [Dependency maintenance](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/DEPENDENCIES.md): Dependabot checks npm dependencies and GitHub Actions workflow references weekly using `.github/dependabot.yml`. It proposes updates as pull requests; review the changes and run CI before merging. The core and engine are pinned to GitHub distribution tags, so check their releases and compatibility when updating those dependencies.
- [Explorer](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/EXPLORER.md): The explorer shows every analysed note on a map, placed by meaning, with the variables and links you choose. It needs the [semantic index](SEMANTIC-INDEX.md) and an analysis (see [the landscape](LANDSCAPE.md)). Nothing leaves your device; a note is changed only when you press **Link** on a suggestion.
- [Landscape](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/LANDSCAPE.md): The landscape shows the vault by meaning: the themes your notes form, how they sit next to each other, how they grew over time and how close they are to the interests you declare. It needs the [semantic index](SEMANTIC-INDEX.md); nothing leaves your device and no note is ever changed.
- [Link graph](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/LINK-GRAPH.md): The link graph shows the explicit links between your notes, laid out by a force simulation: linked notes pull together, and every note pushes the others away.
- [Metrics](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/METRICS.md): Every measure shown by Semantic Atlas has an entry here: definition, layer used, complexity, validity limit and reference. A measure without an entry must not be displayed.
- [Semantic index](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/SEMANTIC-INDEX.md): The semantic index finds notes by their meaning, in French and English alike. It runs on your device with a local embedding model: your notes never leave it.
- [Semantic Atlas — spécification de phase 0](https://github.com/SemanticAtlas/semantic-atlas/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md): 1. [Décisions à valider (résumé)](#1-décisions-à-valider-résumé)
